svg.metadata: {"story":"Nehemiah","act":8,"chapter":"Ch.8 · The Wall Completed","scene":"B","layer":"foreground","artDirection":"The wall is finished in fifty-two days, and the enemies are afraid, knowing the work was done with the help of God. Stage: a finished wall at sunrise, a city gate closed, a man on the wall looking out; the sound of a trumpet, the fear of the neighbours.","materials":["assets/materials/wall_brick-herringbone.svg","assets/materials/stone-flagstone.svg"],"seed":1}
